text:
maria.s: FYI — Acme (acct: acme-pro) escalated live after 03:20 UTC. They report p99 timeouts and lots of 500s hitting their Dedicated pool `eu-west-2-reserved`. Dashboard spike: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/rows?panel=pool-eu-west-2-reserved
maria.s: Quick summary from support: customer saw p95 ~400ms -> ~2s and p99 jumped to ~5s. Errors are mostly attach-timeouts and a few model load 503s. Customer provided a short repro: send 200 small chat requests concurrently for a pinned model. They can reproduce consistently during their morning ramp.

alex.k: Thanks — can folks drop recent autoscaler + deployment events? suspecting scale-up latency + cold GPU init. Any config changes in the last 12h?

opsbot: autoscaler-service: config-change by deploy-bot at 02:10 UTC — autoscaler.min_pool_size for eu-west-2-reserved set from 4 -> 1 (change id: cfg-8821).

sam.r: grabbing traces and queues. Early look: provision queue depth spiked to 250 at 03:22, attach latency 95th moved from 120ms -> 1.2s, attach p99 ~4.6s. Image warmup failures ~12% (timeout during model cache init). Related metrics: GPU init histogram shows distinct cold tail.

jing.w: that cfg change rings a bell — we rolled a smaller default min to lower costs for low-traffic tenants. Looks like Acme's morning ramp hit the lower min and we didn't prewarm. Recommend immediate mitigation: revert min_pool_size to 4 and enable prewarm for that pool + increase attach parallelism.

maria.s: Can someone run the revert and bump now? Customer is holding traffic with a short timeout. Suggested commands: 
```
# revert the config change
redwoodctl config set autoscaler.eu-west-2-reserved.min_pool_size=4 --reason="support-escalation-acme"
# enable prewarm
redwoodctl pool prewarm enable eu-west-2-reserved --concurrency=3
```

sam.r: Applying now — will also seed warmup pods to decrease cold-init tail. Patching policy to favor warm VMs during ramp.

sam.r: done — min_pool_size bumped to 4, prewarm enabled, 6 warm pods seeded. Warmup logs: `warmup: model_cache ready` for 5/6 pods. Rolling monitor: https://redwood.internal/monitoring/pool/eu-west-2-reserved

alex.k: Great. Also please pin fallback model variant for this customer while we stabilize: `model-routing:set acme-pro --fallback=gpt-medium-quant` — reduces load on heavier kernels.

maria.s: I updated the customer: they removed their short-term throttle and are running their ramp. Early telemetry shows p95 down to ~350ms and p99 trending down. Customer said they saw timeouts stop after the retry window (~2m). :thumbsup:

jing.w: Follow-up action items: 1) revert global rollout that lowered default min_pool_size (cfg-8821) or make it opt-in for non-production tenants, 2) add autoscaler safety to keep a warm floor during local morning windows, 3) postmortem to capture why change bypassed smoke checks. I'll own 1+2.

maria.s: Thanks team. If numbers re-spike we'll escalate to infra on-call. For now I'll keep this thread open and update last checks in 30m.

sam.r: will leave extra logs and a short repro script in the ticket: https://redwood.internal/support/tickets/ACME-1287 — includes attach traces and warmup stack dump.

maria.s: closing to follow-up later, but keeping thread pinned.
